import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
from io import StringIO

# Load the dataset from the string
data_string = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data_string))

# --- Visualization ---

# Set a professional and modern style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", rc={"axes.facecolor": "#f0f0f0", "figure.facecolor": "white"})

# Create a figure with a 2x2 grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Financial Transactions', fontsize=20, weight='bold', y=0.98)

# Define a color palette
palette = sns.color_palette("viridis", n_colors=df['transaction_type'].nunique())

# --- Plot 1: Transaction Amount vs. Hour of Day (Scatter Plot) ---
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='hour_of_day',
    y='amount',
    hue='transaction_type',
    size='amount',
    sizes=(100, 1000),
    palette=palette,
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=1,
    ax=ax1,
    legend='full'
)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Hour', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Hour of the Day', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MaxNLocator(integer=True))
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%.2f'))
ax1.legend(title='Transaction Type', loc='upper left')

# --- Plot 2: Distribution of Transaction Amounts (Violin + Swarm Plot) ---
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', palette=palette, inner=None, ax=ax2, cut=0)
sns.swarmplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', color='black', size=8, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_title('Amount Distribution by Transaction Type', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
ax2.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%.2f'))
ax2.grid(True, axis='y', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

# --- Plot 3: Count of Each Transaction Type (Bar Plot) ---
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
count_plot = sns.countplot(
    data=df,
    x='transaction_type',
    palette=palette,
    ax=ax3,
    order=df['transaction_type'].value_counts().index,
    edgecolor='black'
)
ax3.set_title('Frequency of Transaction Types', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
ax3.grid(True, axis='y', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)
# Add count labels on top of bars
for p in ax3.patches:
    ax3.annotate(f'{int(p.get_height())}', (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                 ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, color='black', xytext=(0, 5),
                 textcoords='offset points')

# --- Plot 4: Distribution of Transactions Over the Day (Histogram) ---
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.histplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', bins=12, kde=True, color=palette[1], ax=ax4, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_title('Transaction Timing Distribution', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of the Day', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_xticks(range(0, 25, 2))
ax4.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

# --- Final Adjustments & Save ---
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95]) # Adjust for suptitle
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
